game.name: Digimon World 3: Definitive Edition
game.desc: Digimon World 3: Definitive Edition — a native source port of Digimon World 2003 (PAL) with Persona-style elemental weakness combat, rebalanced progression, Hunt/Forge/Black Market/DRI systems, and an in-game Guide. Needs your own copy of the PAL disc in ports/dw3/game/.
